coins.note: Beans are valued at TOKEN_PAYOUT_USD dollars each (0.013 unless you set the environment variable). Net revenue per coin is computed from the cheapest pack in PACKS after the worst-case store fee, so no commission or bonus can ever be larger than what was really collected.

promo.note: Promo credits are call minutes. They never pay Beans and never trigger a referral commission. Existing accounts keep their old free tokens as call minutes (up to legacyMaxMinutes); everything above what they really bought is removed from the coin balance.

referral.note: Percent of NET PLATFORM REVENUE on a Paid_Coin spend (net of store fees and after the creator's Beans). Held 7 days before it can be withdrawn.
